_note: STARTING POINT — curated by ClauseWise maintainers. Review and extend before each release. Not legal advice; used only for severity comparison within the tool.

typical_patterns.typical: 1–2 months' rent, returned within 14–30 days of move-out minus documented deductions.
red_flags: deposit exceeds 2 months
no stated return timeline
landlord sole judge of deductions
non-refundable deposit language

typical_patterns.typical: 30 days written notice by either party (60 days in many jurisdictions for month-to-month).
red_flags: notice period exceeds 90 days for tenant
landlord requires shorter notice than tenant
no written notice requirement

typical_patterns.typical: Annual increase capped at CPI or a fixed percentage (e.g., 5%). Many jurisdictions cap increases by law.
red_flags: landlord may increase rent at any time
no cap stated
increase more than 10% annually
increase with fewer than 30 days notice

typical_patterns.typical: Landlord responsible for structural, plumbing, electrical, heating. Tenant responsible for minor cosmetic repairs and normal wear.
red_flags: tenant liable for all repairs regardless of cause
tenant must maintain appliances at own cost
no timeline given for landlord response to repairs

typical_patterns.typical: Penalty of 1–2 months' rent or forfeiture of deposit if tenant breaks lease early. Landlord duty to mitigate by re-letting.
red_flags: tenant liable for all rent through end of term regardless of re-letting
no landlord duty to mitigate
penalty exceeds 3 months' rent

typical_patterns.typical: 24–48 hours' written notice required except in emergencies.
red_flags: landlord may enter at any time without notice
notice shorter than 24 hours
no emergency exception defined

typical_patterns.typical: Permitted with landlord consent not to be unreasonably withheld.
red_flags: subletting absolutely prohibited
no consent process defined
tenant remains liable even after approved sublet without clear terms

typical_patterns.typical: Local landlord-tenant tribunal or small claims court. Both parties bear own costs unless award is made.
red_flags: mandatory binding arbitration waiving court rights
tenant pays landlord legal fees regardless of outcome
jurisdiction clause in a distant location
